code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Find the divider color-2 line and colored marks beside it; extend the marks
    # one cell away from the divider in color 8.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    line_cols=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==2 for r in range(h))]
    if not line_cols: return out
    c=line_cols[0]
    marks=[(r,x) for r in range(h) for x in range(w) if grid[r][x] not in (2,5)]
    if not marks: return out
    # Extend the colored pattern outward from the divider.
    if all(x<c for r,x in marks):
        edge=min(x for r,x in marks)
        target=edge-1
    else:
        edge=max(x for r,x in marks)
        target=edge+1
    if 0<=target<w:
        for r,x in marks:
            out[r][target]=8
    return out
'''
